en: Archive: the frosted glass on the cases that are not selected (their covers blurred, as since 1.0) can be switched off, so every cover shows sharp: right-click the Archive › Frosted glass on the cases, or GLASS under DISPLAY › ARCHIVE in 05 STYLE.
The header no longer overlaps itself in a narrow window: the navigation drops its numbers first, then the clock and the wordmark's text give way, and at last the navigation shows only the numbers.
zh: 档案：未选中外壳的磨砂玻璃（自 1.0 起封面会被模糊）现在可以关闭，让所有封面都清晰显示：档案右键 › 外壳磨砂玻璃，或 05 外观 › 显示 › 档案 下的 玻璃。
窄窗口下顶栏不再重叠：导航先去掉编号，再依次隐藏时钟与标志文字，最后只显示编号。
